layers.label: Alpha Foundation
layers.definition: Separate pure rules, browser presentation, progression and inspection.
layers.check: Supported schema and complete engine API.

layers.label: Blueprint Alignment
layers.definition: Seeded generation creates a stable, playable opening.
layers.check: 64 cells, no initial free triples, at least one legal move.

layers.label: Core Compliance
layers.definition: Stable tile identities carry a symbol and optional earned power.
layers.check: Unique IDs, bounded symbols, supported power types.

layers.label: Deterministic Direction
layers.definition: Pointer gestures and keyboard/click selection enter the same swap transaction.
layers.check: Actual pointer gesture count; keyboard-native tile controls.

layers.label: Energy Engine
layers.definition: One committed rule transaction is presented before new input is accepted.
layers.check: UI lock state and atomic rule-phase status.

layers.label: Facilitation Force
layers.definition: Surviving tiles preserve order and fall into cleared cells; new tiles enter above.
layers.check: Every settled column contains eight valid tiles.

layers.label: Grid Geometry
layers.definition: Row/column and linear-index conversions preserve position.
layers.check: Index → row/column → index round-trips for all 64 cells.

layers.label: Homeplace Harmony
layers.definition: Hints enumerate productive adjacent swaps without predicting refills.
layers.check: A hint is present while active and is geometrically adjacent.

layers.label: Invariant Integrity
layers.definition: A nonmatching swap restores the exact previous board and spends no move.
layers.check: Rejected transaction signatures agree.

layers.label: Judiciary Justice
layers.definition: Score targets, retries and local win records make progress visible.
layers.check: Nonnegative score, budget and local run records.

layers.label: Key Lockout
layers.definition: Swaps, clear flashes and tile arrival animate with a reduced-motion path.
layers.check: Rendered animations exercised or reduced-motion alternative selected.

layers.label: Literalist Logic
layers.definition: Every proposed move is checked against adjacency, matches and powers.
layers.check: All current candidates are legal adjacent pairs.

layers.label: Mastery Mind
layers.definition: Maximal horizontal/vertical runs merge into connected clear components.
layers.check: Settled board has no unresolved normal match.

layers.label: Nomad Navigation
layers.definition: Edges cannot wrap into a false neighbor and diagonals are rejected.
layers.check: Row-wrap and diagonal counterexamples are rejected.

layers.label: Order Observation
layers.definition: Target completion wins; exhausting moves below target loses.
layers.check: Outcome is consistent with current score and move budget.

layers.label: Protection Protocol
layers.definition: Four-runs make line powers, intersections make blasts, five-runs make spectra.
layers.check: Current power types are supported; creation/activation counts are real.

layers.label: Query Precision
layers.definition: Structural validation and executable rule/browser tests catch broken behavior.
layers.check: Current state round-trips; full regression results remain a separate artifact.

layers.label: Replication Rite
layers.definition: Clear, activate, score, fall, refill and repeat to a stable board.
layers.check: No unresolved match; bounded cascade traces and counters.

layers.label: Sovereign Stream
layers.definition: Opt-in generated sound, labeled native buttons, live status and reduced motion.
layers.check: Current DOM labels, status announcements and explicit sound preference.

layers.label: Target Triumph
layers.definition: Only accepted swaps spend turns; animation delays never change game rules.
layers.check: Moves remain within budget, independent of rendering delays.

layers.label: Unified Utility
layers.definition: The score, turns, target and outcome reflect the current engine state.
layers.check: Displayed HUD matches current engine counters.

layers.label: Vector Velocity
layers.definition: Original CSS gems, clear flashes and earned-power badges expose real events.
layers.check: All 64 rendered cells have distinct accessible identities.

layers.label: Western Warfare
layers.definition: Terminal states are immutable until a new attempt is explicitly started.
layers.check: Terminal status is valid; replay remains a separate action.

layers.label: Xerox Exactness
layers.definition: Versioned JSON transfers full state; malformed imports preserve the running game.
layers.check: Save/restore preserves the exact current session.

layers.label: Yielding Light
layers.definition: Six symbols, visible targets and earned powers create measurable tradeoffs.
layers.check: Six-color rules and positive explicit target/budget.

layers.label: Zenith Zero
layers.definition: A dead board reshuffles without spending a move or resetting score.
layers.check: An active settled board has at least one productive move.
